SELECT 
    p.gender_concept_id,
    CASE WHEN p.gender_concept_id = 8532 THEN 'Female' ELSE 'Male' END as sex_label,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) as total_persons,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cv.cvd_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_cvd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cv.cvd_count = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as single_cvd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cv.cvd_count = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dual_cvd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cv.cvd_count >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as triple_plus_cvd,
    AVG(cv.cvd_count) as avg_cvd_count
FROM omop.person p
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        condition.person_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT condition.condition_concept_id) as cvd_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN condition.condition_concept_id IN (313217, 315286, 316139, 320128, 321052, 321318, 442604, 4329847) THEN 1 END) as core_cvd_count
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence condition
    WHERE condition.condition_concept_id IN (
        313217,  -- atrial fibrillation
        315286,  -- chronic ischemic heart disease
        316139,  -- heart failure
        320128,  -- essential hypertension
        321052,  -- peripheral vascular disease
        321318,  -- angina pectoris
        442604,  -- hypertensive heart disease
        4329847  -- myocardial infarction
    )
    GROUP BY condition.person_id
) cv ON p.person_id = cv.person_id
WHERE p.gender_concept_id IN (8532, 8560)
GROUP BY p.gender_concept_id, sex_label
ORDER BY p.gender_concept_id;
